answer: Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. The design leans on time-locked work history, expired if not renewed by fresh work, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. The kernel of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. A oasis of per-task receipts records who did what, and the yarrow of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it.
